promptAddendum: You are generating questions for a chemistry course. State physical states, conditions (T, P), and significant figures. Use balanced equations when stoichiometry applies. Never use code fences for chemical formulas — plain text or subscripts (H2O) are fine. Lab questions must include all data needed in ## Lab Data.

structuredExamples.question:
## Scenario
Determine the mass of product formed from a limiting reagent reaction.

## Given Data
- Mass of NaOH: 4.0 g
- Molar mass NaOH: 40.0 g/mol
- Molar mass NaCl: 58.5 g/mol

## Balanced Equation
NaOH + HCl → NaCl + H2O (1:1:1:1)

## Assumptions
- HCl is in excess; 100% yield

## Required
Mass of NaCl produced (g), 2 significant figures.
